bugs.title: Masters hub link 'Hold reasons' (/masters/m/hold-reasons) opens the Floor Plans master. The custom hold reasons kept by the refresh cannot be seen or managed in the UI.
bugs.evidence: Browser check refresh-keeps-setup: on /masters/m/hold-reasons the page h1 reads 'Floor Plans' (screenshot refresh-keeps-setup-hold-reasons.png). Cause: MastersHub.jsx:54 links 'Hold reasons' to /masters/m/hold-reasons, but pages/master/masterConfig.js has no kind 'hold-reasons' (it has no 'allocation-categories' either, which is linked at MastersHub.jsx:53), so MasterPage falls back to the first config. The API is healthy: GET /api/master/hold-reasons -> 200 and lists 'tscheck custom reason' and 'Token received (custom)' after the refresh (e1_tests/test_tscheck_refresh_keeps_ids.py::test_masters_kept passed).

action_items.detail: Two demo refreshes were triggered, not one. The first POST /api/admin/demo-refresh/run (04:17:42 UTC) stopped with 'interrupted: backend restarted mid-run' 1 minute in. My own file write to /app/backend/e1_tests caused this, because uvicorn WatchFiles watches /app/backend. Before running again I checked the data: 78 active bookings, MTD ₹1,55,50,930 and outstanding ₹7,42,79,994 were all unchanged. One full refresh then ran from 04:19 to 04:27:09 UTC (outcome 'done', backup test_database-20261116T041903Z.archive.gz). Also note for the main agent: any write under /app/backend, including e1_tests, restarts the backend and will abort a running refresh.

Several older e1_tests hard-code numbers from earlier seeds that the reseeds have since moved on from: test_tscheck_home_today (MTD 15485546), reports_agree, not_due_bills, journey_order (BK-2526-1348/1349/1352), next_stage_preview, refresh_state (old hold-reason list and backup assertions), and split_reversal (setup error, booking gone). They fail against today's data and are not counted here. The current matrix is covered by the new files test_tscheck_headline_iter4.py, test_tscheck_hold_expiry.py and test_tscheck_refresh_keeps_ids.py, plus test_tscheck_business_day.py, which now targets BK-2526-2219.

Home Recent activity shows each receipt twice, e.g. 2x 'Payment · post KKT/2627/17087'. The API returns two audit rows with different payment entity ids under the same receipt number. This is probably the Cash/Account split of one receipt, but it reads as a duplicate. Also, System Health 'Last backup' shows the time in browser-local format (11/16/2026, 4:19:07 AM), not IST.
